opening_title: Error: EACCES: permission denied, scandir .pytest_cache with 8.2.0

expected_outcome.rationale: The 8.2.0 cache-permission regression prevents a different user from reading .pytest_cache after a container run. It differs from ENOSYS on a read-only squashfuse mount during assertion rewriting. Full package list and Fedora 39/Ubuntu 22.04 versions are given. The external CI trace is detailed but the opening lacks an isolated workflow/reproducer; the later reproduction repository is annotation only.

human_review.reviewer: requesting user (explicitly delegated review to Codex and accepted its confirmation)
